messages:
sophie: Hey design — planning a benchmark blog + webinar. New ask: we need an interactive embeddable chart (iframe/JS) for the blog that mirrors the static hero art. It should be keyboard accessible and provide CSV download.

kevin: Interactive? ok. Do we still want static variations for social + slides?

sophie: Yes — static PNG/SVG for 1600x900 slide, 1200x600 blog hero, and 1080x1080 social. Interactive version should be responsive and include a compact mobile layout.

lee: Can you paste the data to seed the interactive?

sophie: Use this prototype CSV (exact values for dev):

```
deployment,median_latency_ms,usd_per_1k
hosted,42,0.85
dedicated,30,1.40
private,65,1.10
```

kevin: Design constraints?

sophie: Follow brand tokens but include a high-contrast theme. Primary: #1F3BFF, Accent: #00B37E, Ink: #101316. Add alt palette for color-blind (blue + orange) and a dark-mode inversion. Provide WCAG contrast checks in the redlines.

marco: For the interactive: prefer an accessible tooltip (escape with ESC), keyboard focusable legend (tab to toggle series), and an aria-live region that announces value changes. Also add a small control to toggle batching/quantization overlays (on/off).

lee: Animation? micro-interactions?

sophie: Subtle draw-in for the lines on load, hover pulse on data points, and a small Lottie loop for the webinar intro (5-7s). Lottie should be exportable from the same components.

isabel: Deliverables checklist from marketing:
- Figma master with components and tokens
- Static exports: SVG + PNG for three sizes
- Interactive micro-frontend: HTML/CSS/JS bundle (vanilla or small lib), iframe wrapper, CSV endpoint stub, README for devs
- Lottie + MP4 + GIF for intro
- Redlines doc with contrast ratios, font stack, accessibility notes, and alt text for each image
- Translation placeholders (EN/JA/DE) in text layers

design-bot: QA checklist: attach source CSV, include alt text templates, verify 4.5:1 contrast for body and 3:1 for UI, ensure SVGs preserve text layers, tag exports with locale and version. :white_check_mark:

marco: Naming convention request for exports: en_US_v1_1600x900.png, en_US_v1_interactive.zip, en_US_v1_lottie.json. Also keep a README frame in figma called EXPORT_GUIDELINES.

kevin: Legal & claims: avoid precise percent claims until signoff. Add small legal layer: "bench data internal, pending review" and keep numeric text editable.

sophie: Timeline: initial figma + one static export + basic interactive stub by Tue EOD (2001234578). Finalized kit + interactive bundle + Lottie by next Fri.

lee: I'll start mocks today and post figma link.

isabel: I'll prep copy variations and provide JA/DE placeholders: {JA_COPY}, {DE_COPY}.

kevin: Great — I'll book 25m on Wed to review interactive accessibility flows.

sophie: Thanks team — keep layers native and do not flatten type. Ping when draft up. :rocket:
